description:
Subject: Mortgage Overview for Your New Home Purchase  

Dear Client,  

We have prepared the preliminary loan package for the property you are interested in. The mortgage will be based on a loan amount of $250,000, financed over a 30‑year term with an annual interest rate of 3.75 %. Your upfront down payment will be $25,000. In addition to principal and interest, you should budget for the recurring costs of $3,500 per year in property taxes and $1,200 per year for homeowner’s insurance.  

Please review these figures at your convenience and let us know if you have any questions or would like to discuss alternative options. We look forward to moving ahead with the next steps in securing your financing.  

Best regards,  
Your Mortgage Services Team
